_readme: THE ONE PLACE THAT SAYS WHERE EACH PACK LIVES. Every script and workflow finds a pack through this file
(scripts/lib/packs.js), by its stable key, never by a hardcoded folder name. To move or rename a pack: git mv the
folder, change its "dir" here, run `node scripts/lib/packs.js check`, done. Keys never change; folders may.
"automated" names what reads the pack on a schedule; "dir" is relative to sm-content/.
